findings.description: The truck parked outside the diner changes from a white semi-truck at the beginning of the video (00:00) to a dark green truck.
When the waitress stands up from the counter stool to walk behind the counter, a second identical clone of the waitress is already standing in the background near the kitchen pass-through.
